title: Eigenvalues of the tetradiagonal Toeplitz matrices with diagonals 1, 0, 0, 1
summary: We perform a thorough analysis of the eigenvalues of tetradiagonal Toeplitz matrices of large order $n$ generated by the Laurent polynomial $a(t)=t^2+t^{-1}$. The spectra of these matrices are invariant under $2π/3$-rotation. They are contained in three segments of the complex plane and asymptotically fill these segments as $n$ tends to infinity. We apply Widom's formula for the determinants and transform the characteristic equation into a convenient form that can be solved by the fixed point iteration method.
